purpose: Support an offline comparison of conditions, units, categories and missing information for three pinned components without reproducing full datasheets.

components.input_quantity: temperature at the component under the declared test condition
components.transduction_principle: temperature-dependent resistance of an NTC thermistor

fields.name: response_time
fields.conditions: retain the datasheet definition and test condition; do not substitute for thermal time constant

fields.name: thermal_time_constant
fields.conditions: retain the datasheet definition and test condition; not interchangeable with response time

fields.name: dissipation_factor
fields.conditions: used only to reason about self-heating under declared surroundings

claim_boundaries: component response time is not automatically the response time of a measurement chain
datasheet values do not validate body-temperature measurement

components.document: Official product catalog entry 125UNA and item MMF404325
components.input_quantity: mechanical strain transferred to the bonded grid
components.transduction_principle: piezoresistive response of a bonded metallic strain-gage grid

fields.name: grid_pattern
fields.conditions: single-grid geometry identified by the official 125UNA catalog pattern

fields.name: self_temperature_compensation_code
fields.conditions: must be interpreted for the declared target material and installation

fields.name: gauge_factor
fields.conditions: obtain from the package or certificate for the actual lot; the generic page is insufficient

claim_boundaries: nominal grid resistance does not determine force or pressure
a strain-gage specification does not validate a complete biomedical device

components.document: Official product page and S5821-03 datasheet
components.input_quantity: incident optical power with wavelength and geometry declared
components.transduction_principle: photoelectric conversion in a silicon PIN photodiode

fields.name: spectral_response_range
fields.conditions: spectral response range; responsivity varies with wavelength

fields.name: photosensitivity
fields.conditions: wavelength 780 nm under the datasheet test condition

fields.name: dark_current
fields.conditions: reverse voltage VR = 10 V under the datasheet temperature condition

fields.name: cutoff_frequency
fields.conditions: reverse voltage VR = 10 V under the datasheet circuit condition

fields.name: terminal_capacitance
fields.conditions: reverse voltage VR = 10 V and test frequency 1 MHz

claim_boundaries: photodiode cutoff frequency is not automatically the bandwidth of the measurement chain
photocurrent is not converted into physiological concentration or oximetry without an independent validated model
